name: Yahaba (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yahaba town emblem in white: an outlined star-like device of three stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Yahaba, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 September 1957.

features.role: Yahaba town emblem — an outlined star-like device of three stylised characters
